prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Spectrum 1-10: page #1C1D16, text #F5F7F3, accent #8AE59A, secondary surface #252C37, text on accent #111111. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in Inter; architectural sans heading with neutral interface text. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 18px, heading 48px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
